escalations.why: risk.Drawdown is specified as (ticker, depth, peak_date) with no trough date, but RISK-05 requires the date of the peak and the date of the trough, REP-01 requires the report row to hold both dates, and the TC-08 oracle (tests/fixtures/risk/TC-08/expected.json) carries trough_date per ticker. M1-T04 is the interface task that freezes Drawdown (CR-09), so freezing it as written would block M1-T12 (TC-08) and REP-01 later. Proposed: Drawdown: ticker: str; depth: float; peak_date: str; trough_date: str. Related: the planned layout puts TickerSummary, Drawdown and Report in risk/types.py, and the contract names them as risk.* exports, but M1-T04's Writes include neither packages/risk/src/risk/types.py nor packages/risk/src/risk/__init__.py, so the Revise should also add types.py to M1-T04's Writes (or say the types live in summary.py, drawdown.py and report.py).
